title: Apex - Tactical Heatmaps
description: Spatial-binned tactical heatmaps (casualty, enemy contact, engagement, fire support, risk, supply vulnerability, comms blackout) computed by server/analytics/engine.js#computeHeatmap. Queries assume grid cells are persisted to a `heatmap_cells` table (type, lat, lng, intensity, generated_at).

targets.rawSql: SELECT lat, lng, intensity FROM heatmap_cells WHERE type = '$heatmap_type' AND generated_at = (SELECT MAX(generated_at) FROM heatmap_cells WHERE type = '$heatmap_type')

SELECT lat AS "Lat", lng AS "Lng", intensity AS "Intensity" FROM heatmap_cells WHERE type = '$heatmap_type' AND generated_at = (SELECT MAX(generated_at) FROM heatmap_cells WHERE type = '$heatmap_type') ORDER BY intensity DESC LIMIT 20
